headline: Autodesk (ADSK) Joins OpenUSD Push As ISO Process Starts For 3D Standards
summary: Autodesk joined the Alliance for OpenUSD effort to drive global 3D data interoperability and agentic AI workflows. The alliance has begun the ISO certification process for the OpenUSD Core Specification 1.1. This move targets broader adoption of OpenUSD as a common 3D data layer across gaming, XR, and enterprise use cases. Autodesk, traded as NasdaqGS:ADSK, is tying its software ecosystem more closely to OpenUSD at a time when 3D content and AI driven workflows are gaining attention across...
